name: postgresql_replication_role_changed
title: Postgresql replication role changed
description: The replication role (primary/replica) has just changed, which usually indicates a failover happened. Verify whether this was expected.

source.upstream_description: The replication role (primary/replica) of {{ $labels.instance }} has just changed, which usually indicates a failover happened. Verify whether this was expected.
source.query_normalized: The upstream threshold could not be lifted out of the expression (its outermost operator is and/or/unless, or it compares against another series), so the expression is normalised to 1 per matching series and the alert fires on any match. The observed value in the notification is therefore always 1.
